messages:
Jon: Heads-up — onboarding acme-ml-prod needs 8x NDv4 A100 GPUs in westeurope for a short training burst starting 2026-04-05. Need quota + capacity reservation (dedicated). Can someone open the Azure request and track?
Maya: Which exact SKU and whether we want a capacity reservation or just quota? NDv4 variants differ. Also need network limits checked (NICs, public IPs).
Sam: I can own the portal ticket. Suggest we request: SKU=Standard_NDv4_A100, count=8, region=westeurope, dedicated capacity reservation, start=2026-04-05, duration=7 days. Will include subscription 9f2b-8c3d-acme-prod.
Maya: ok that's the SKU we usually test. Reminder: require Accelerated Networking and ensure VM size supports it. I'll pull current usage to avoid vCPU conflict.
Sam: Draft payload (will paste to MS form):
```json
{
  "subscriptionId": "9f2b8c3d-acme-prod",
  "region": "westeurope",
  "sku": "Standard_NDv4_A100",
  "count": "8",
  "startDate": "2026-04-05",
  "durationDays": "7",
  "reservationType": "CapacityReservation",
  "preemptible": "false",
  "tags": ["team:infra","tenant:acme-ml-prod"]
}
```
Also run `az vm list-usage --location westeurope` to capture current quotas and attach to the ticket.
Lina: Add network quota bumps please: publicIPAddresses 50->100, networkInterfaces 400->500, loadBalancers 5->10 (for routing / inference frontends). Also request an increase for Standard Accelerated Networking NICs if that's a separate limit.
infra-bot: Support ticket created: MS-87654321 (https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/SupportBlade/selectedTicket/MS-87654321). Initial response expected within 24-48h.
Sam: MS responded: they need subscription owner confirmation and an estimate of committed spend for approval. Pinging finance and the account owner.
Aviv: Can we include a fallback plan? If ND capacity not available, ask for temporary approval for 8x NC24rs_v3 in westeurope or northeurope as a backfill. Add note about performance delta and verify compatibility.
Maya: Good call — I'll add NC fallback to the ticket and mark it as "must-have fallback". Also added a note to require IP forwarding disabled for security.
Jon: Budget for this burst is ~€5k. Please tag the ticket INFRA-3421 and cc me on the support thread. I'll approve spend once the estimate is attached.
Sam: Done — ticket updated with fallback and cost estimate placeholder. Linking internal tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-3421.
Lina: MS asked for a contact who can approve quota changes. @Jon can you confirm?
Jon: Confirmed — I'm the approver for acme-ml-prod. CC me on MS support replies.
infra-bot: MS updated ticket MS-87654321: assigned to Azure Capacity team. ETA: 72 hours for capacity reservation confirmation.
Sam: Will follow up in 48h and escalate to account team if no reply. Also attaching `az vm list-usage` output to the ticket.
Aviv: One more ask — ensure the reservation is created under the correct billing scope (reserved under enterprise agreement / subscription 9f2b8c3d) so costs are visible to finance.
Maya: Noted. I'll double-check billing scope before finalizing the portal request.
Jon: Excellent. Thanks all — keep updates in this thread and add any MS ticket replies. :thumbsup:
